title: Well-defined matrices for the expansion of intestinal stem cells and organoids
protocol: Allow peptides TG-Gln, TG-DG-Lys, and TG-NDG-Lys to reach room temperature.
Weigh appropriate amounts of peptides for functionalizing 1 g of PEG-VS or PEG-Acr, ensuring a 1.2 molar excess of peptide to PEG.
Prepare mixes in a 50-ml Falcon tube: PEG-VS and TG-Gln; PEG-VS and TG-DG-Lys; PEG-VS and TG-NDG-Lys; PEG-Acr and TG-Gln; PEG-Acr and TG-NDG-Lys.
Add 40 ml of 0.3 M TEA buffer to each tube to dissolve the powder.
Incubate tubes in a 37°C water bath for 2 h, with occasional mixing by tube inversion.
Transfer tube contents into SnakeSkin dialysis tubing, rinsing the tube with additional 10 ml of 0.3 M TEA.
Clamp one side of the tubing with a heavy plastic clamp before filling.
Close the tubing with a light plastic clamp after filling it with liquid.
Attach a floater to the top side of the tubing and suspend it in a 5-L glass beaker filled with ultrapure water containing a magnetic stirrer.
Dialyze for 4 days at 4°C with stirring, changing the water three times per day (morning, noon, evening).
Separate each dialysis tube's contents into four 50-ml Falcon tubes (approximately 14 ml per tube).
Close the tube with a rubber band-fastened Kimwipe.
Freeze by immersing into a tank of liquid nitrogen.
Lyophilize for two days.
Combine lyophilates into a single pre-weighed 50-ml Falcon tube and re-weigh to determine product weight.
Add autoclaved Milli-Q water to make a 13.33% (w/v) PEG stock solution for each precursor.
Filter the solutions using a 0.2-μm filter.
Make 13.33% (w/v) premixes of complementary macromers at volumetric ratios listed in Table 1.
Mix [PEG-Acr]-Gln with [PEG-VS]-NDG-Lys to make a 50% PEG-Acr mix.
Mix [PEG-Acr]-Gln with [PEG-Acr]-NDG-Lys to make a 100% PEG-Acr mix.
Mix equal volumes of 50% PEG-Acr and 100% PEG-Acr to create a 75% PEG-Acr precursor solution.
Prepare CaCl2-containing TBS with a final concentration of 50 mM for PEG hydrogel formation.
Mix PEG precursor, Lys-RGD, and FXIIIa into the prepared CaCl2-TBS solution to achieve final concentrations as specified.
Allow gel formation at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Cast 50 μl droplets of liquid non-crosslinked gel mix onto a SigmaCote-treated microscope glass slide.
Place 1 cm × 1 cm × 1 mm plastic spacers on both ends of the slide and sandwich the droplets with another SigmaCote-treated slide.
Secure the slides by clamping with standard binder clips on both sides.
Allow gel formation at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Insert 2 ml of ultrapure water between the slides to prevent gel damage during de-casting.
Gently detach the bottom and top surfaces of the gel discs from the glass slides with a flat and thin metal spatula.
Unclamp the binder clips, remove the top slide, and carefully transfer each gel to a separate well of a 12-well plate filled with 1.5 ml of autoclaved Milli-Q water.
Allow the gels to swell overnight at 37°C.
Perform small-strain oscillatory shear measurements on a Bohlin CVO 120 rheometer using the parallel plate configuration.
Measure gel shear moduli at a constant strain of 5% and a range of frequencies from 0.1 to 10 Hz.
Expand ISCs in ~1.3 kPa PEG-VS gels formed by crosslinking \[PEG-VS]-NDG-Lys and \[PEG-VS]-Gln.
Determine the polymer content needed for gel stiffness optimal for ISC expansion through rheometry.
Culture ISCs in a range of 2.5-3.5% (w/v) PEG-VS gels.
Prepare a \[PEG-VS]-NDG-Lys/\[PEG-VS]-Gln gel mix at an appropriate polymer content containing 1 mM RGD.
Incorporate a suspension of dissociated ISCs into the gel mix at a final concentration of 200-500 cells/μl.
Cast 15-20 μl droplets of the gel mix onto the bottom of a 24-well plate.
Allow for gelation to occur (15 min, 37°C).
Flip the plate between upright and upside-down positions every minute during the first 5 minutes of gelation.
Overlay the gels with 600 μl of complete ISC expansion medium.
Supplement the medium with EGF at a concentration of 50 ng/ml.
Add Noggin to the medium at a concentration of 100 ng/ml.
Include R-spondin in the medium at a concentration of 500 ng/ml.
Add CHIR99021 to the medium at a concentration of 3 μM.
Supplement the medium with valproic acid at a concentration of 1 mM.
Include thiazovivin in the medium at a concentration of 2.5 μM.
Replenish growth factors and small molecules every two days.
Change the full medium every four days.
Prepare a 75% PEG-Acr gel mix at the appropriate polymer content.
Include 1 mM RGD and 0.2 mg/ml laminin in the gel mix.
Incorporate a suspension of dissociated ISCs into the gel mix, aiming for a final concentration of 200-500 cells/μl.
Cast 15-20 μl droplets of the gel mix onto the bottom of a 24-well plate.
Allow gelation to occur for 15 minutes at 37°C.
Overlay gels with 600 μl of complete ISC expansion medium.
Incubate for 4 days to allow ISC colonies to form.
Wash once with PBS.

Overlay organoids with organoid formation medium: Advanced DMEM/F12 containing Glutamax, HEPES, penicillin-streptomycin, B27, N2 and 1 μM N-acetylcysteine supplemented with EGF (50 ng/ml), Noggin (100 ng/ml) and R-spondin (500 ng/ml).
